points.description: States that there is no gap (no break/component/resistance) between terminal 4 and the positive terminal, i.e. they are directly connected, so there is no potential difference between them. Equivalent wording accepted.

rubric.notes: Full mark for saying terminal 4 and the positive terminal are directly connected with no gap/component between them (so no potential difference). No mark for unrelated explanations such as a faulty meter or flat battery.
